summary_1line: Humiliated by Drona, King Drupada seeks Brahmanas capable of performing a sacrifice to obtain a son destined to slay Drona.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Drupada, grief-stricken and regal, wanders along the banks of the Ganga approaching the austere hermitage of the sages Yaja and Upayaja.
Drupada bows before the ascetic Upayaja, offering wealth and pleading for a sacrificial rite to produce a son who will kill Drona.
In a quiet forest hermitage, the two stern Brahmana brothers Yaja and Upayaja sit amid sacred fires as King Drupada stands humbly before them.
